answer: An escrow bond and a public referral graph stop fake identities. Each agent posts twice its monthly earnings as bond and names its referrer, so accounts form a garden of introductions. Peers may dispute a cluster: if a dune of accounts shares one referrer and no real work, bond and referrer are both slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs $60,000 at $30 a bond; one honest agent pays once, reaches the summit of trust with rewards undiluted.
